verdict.rationale: Pipecat documents Smart Turn Detection, an ML model that decides when the user has finished speaking. It uses intonation and linguistic cues rather than silence alone, and turn detection automatically accounts for each STT service's measured latency. This covers the core of model-based end-of-turn detection beyond VAD timeouts. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of handling slow speakers or mid-utterance pauses, configuration and tuning details, clarity on whether it works outside Pipecat Cloud (the guide sits under the Cloud docs), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
